name: Linebreaker (Martialist Archetype)
body:
Those who use both hands to wield a great weapon place offense above all else. A linebreaker is one such warrior, using perfect leverage and a keen study of movement to wade into a wall of spears and cut down their foes.

Mighty Finesse

This class feature is as the martialist’s finesse class feature, except that it also allows the Weapon Finesse feat to be applied to any flail, spear, or one-handed heavy blade.

Techniques

The linebreaker may use a finessable weapon in two hands and gain the benefit of the agile swordplay, einhander and improved agile swordplay techniques, if he has them. This modifies some techniques in the technique class feature.

In The Thick (Ex)

At 5th level, a linebreaker is trained to use opponent’s weapons against one another, letting them tangle each other up while the linebreaker remains untouched. For each opponent wielding a reach weapon who threatens the linebreaker beyond the first, he gains a +1 shield bonus to AC. This shield bonus has a maximum of +2. This replaces the uncanny dodge class feature.

Earth Divider (Ex)

At 11th level, a linebreaker uses the weight of their weapon to smash a foe’s defenses. After successfully hitting a creature as a standard action or by using Spring Attack, that creature takes a -2 penalty to its AC until the start of the linebreaker’s next turn. This replaces the improved uncanny dodge class feature.
